title: Loreley: Repository-Scale Program Evolution with Quality-Diversity Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.19703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential agent search accumulates changes from its current champion but discards alternative branches; independent proposals preserve breadth but restart from the root. Loreley instead retains complete repository states in a Quality-Diversity (QD) archive and samples them as parents or supplies them as context for later edits. Candidates are Git commits produced in isolated worktrees and judged by a project-supplied evaluator. We compare configured Loreley QD, sequential champion editing, and independent root proposals in a matched Zstandard experiment: seven paired blocks and 48 physical candidate jobs per policy and block (1,008 total), with root-only initialization and each policy's native concurrency. Validation selected a winner at each budget checkpoint; an agent-hidden holdout measured the fixed candidate. translated_title: 洛雷利：基于质量-多样性搜索的仓库级程序演化
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19703v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：顺序代理搜索会从当前最佳方案中累积更改，但会丢弃替代分支；独立提议保留广度，但会从根节点重新开始。洛雷利（Loreley）则相反，它在质量-多样性（QD）存档中保留完整的仓库状态，并将它们作为父节点采样或作为后续编辑的上下文提供。候选是生成在隔离工作树中的Git提交，并由项目提供的评估器进行评判。我们在匹配的Zstandard实验中比较了配置好的洛雷利QD、顺序冠军编辑和独立根提议：每个策略和块有七个配对块和48个物理候选作业（总计1,008个），使用仅根初始化及每个策略的原生并发性。验证在每个预算检查点选择胜者；一个代理隐藏的保留集测量固定候选。在48个作业时，QD比顺序冠军低0.135%（配对效应的95% BCa区间：-0.556%至+0.161%），比独立根提议低0.320%。
tldr: 洛雷利通过质量-多样性存档保留完整仓库状态，在仓库级程序演化中平衡探索与利用，性能与顺序冠军相当且优于独立提议。
en_tdlr: Loreley retains complete repository states in a Quality-Diversity archive to balance exploration and exploitation in repository-scale program evolution, performing comparably to sequential champion editing and better than independent proposals.
